title: Prove reindexing before transferring an aggregate
obstacle: A sum, supremum or other indexed construction is being expressed using a different index type.
procedure: State the index map and the exact coverage or multiplicity needed.
Prove the term correspondence and handle empty or exceptional indices.
Apply the aggregate reindexing theorem with its convergence or order hypotheses.
verification: Compile the aggregate identity and inspect its endpoint and convergence conventions.
positive_example: Reindex a finite sum through a proved bijection.
negative_example: Drop repeated or missing terms while claiming an unchanged aggregate.

evidence.note: Editorially generalized guidance under this maintenance policy; no independent effectiveness result or proof acceptance is claimed.
